source: select json from style_cards where id = '0b86b10e-ed5b-4435-ad27-abb7c7c23c0e' (live, verbatim)

forbid: Smooth digital gradients or soft airbrushing
Artificial grunge, distress, or noise textures eating into the artwork
json.medium: Digital illustration mimicking vintage copperplate engraving, etching, or woodcut printmaking.
json.shading: Heavy reliance on dense stippling (dotwork) and cross-hatching to create gradients, volume, and glowing light effects without using smooth digital gradients.
json.texture: Clean and crisp digital output that inherently looks textured due to the drawn stippling and hatching, but features no artificial grunge, distressing, or weathering over the design.
evidence: IMAGE 1, 4: Feature intricate landscape backgrounds (forest/waterfall, desert/UFO) seamlessly integrated behind the main pitbull subject.
IMAGE 3: Exception - Features no background environment, relying solely on the isolated character.
IMAGE 1, 3, 4: Utilize a strict two-color palette of dark ink and a warm vintage sand tone.
IMAGE 2: Exception - Shows an inverted version of the artwork with light linework on a dark background.
IMAGE 2, 3: Demonstrate the locked typography rule with heavy vintage serif text arched above and below the character.
IMAGE 1, 4: Exception - Do not contain any typography.
IMAGE 1, 2, 3, 4: Consistently use meticulous stippling and fine hatching to create all shading, volume, and light effects.

linework.style: Intricate etching, contour hatching, and deliberate pointillism/stippling that builds shape.
linework.weight: Fine, precise, and highly detailed, anchored by clean, solid outer contours.

subjects: Surreal juxtapositions (UFOs, bubble tea, folding camping chairs)
Nature and landscape elements (cacti, pine trees, waterfalls, moons)

typography.vibe: Bold, heavy, retro display serif resembling Cooper Black or similar vintage typography.
typography.placement: Locked: Arched prominently over the top of the illustration and reverse-arched along the bottom edge.

json.composition: Locked composition: A prominently scaled, center-aligned character portrait acting as the hero, sometimes layered in front of an intricate atmospheric background vignette (e.g., starry skies, deserts). When text is present, it strictly frames the subject with a large upward arch at the top and a smaller downward arch at the bottom.
signature_moves: Juxtaposing a highly serious, classical engraving style with absurd or anachronistic elements like boba tea and UFOs
Using dense stippling to depict glowing light sources (moonlight, alien tractor beams)
Portraying stoic pitbulls as heroic, slightly anthropomorphic protagonists
